rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: RLS policy infinite recursion in 20260430_admin_write_policies.sql. The policy 'Admins can manage all profiles' on public.profiles table uses 'EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = auth.uid() AND p.role = 'admin')' which queries the same table the policy is protecting, causing infinite recursion.
reproduction_steps: 4. Observe: 'Profile fetch error: infinite recursion detected in policy for relation profiles'
5. Multiple 500 errors appear for every API call involving profiles
evidence: Console error: 'Profile fetch error: infinite recursion detected in policy for relation "profiles"'
HTTP 500 errors on every authenticated request
Session instability - user gets logged out when navigating between pages
potential_causes: RLS policy on profiles table queries profiles table to check admin role
Supabase evaluates the policy recursively without a base case
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Replace the profiles table policy with one that doesn't query profiles. Options: (1) Use auth.jwt() -> 'user_metadata' -> 'role', (2) Create a SECURITY DEFINER function to check admin role, (3) Use a different approach like checking auth.uid() = id for self-access and a separate admin check
